original_test_intent: Verify the SMBIOS Type 4 External Clock metadata for every expected processor record matches the approved base/reference-clock value in MHz or an explicitly supported unknown value and persists after reboot; it does not measure current core frequency.
original_method: Capture complete raw/decoded Type 4 records, bind by socket/status, retain the raw 16-bit External Clock field and decoded MHz value, compare with the platform's documented reference-clock/unsupported policy, reboot and repeat without changing clocks or running a frequency test.
manual_activity: A user approves the expected reference-clock/unknown policy, socket mapping and reboot plan. Metadata collection and comparison are automatable.
required_inputs: Approved External Clock value in MHz or supported zero/unknown rule
CPU/platform applicability and meaning of the reference clock
Validated raw/decoded tooling and approved reboot/OOB plan
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only; do not change BCLK/reference-clock, overclock settings, CPU policy or firmware.
Preserve raw 16-bit values, decoded MHz, every Type 4 record and errors; grep fragments are incomplete evidence.
Do not compare External Clock directly with dynamic core frequency, Max Speed or Current Speed.
Do not reject zero/unknown or accept a legacy nominal value without project-approved platform applicability.
Stop on invalid units, missing/duplicate records, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete Type 4 evidence, bind sockets/status and compare raw/decoded External Clock metadata with the approved per-platform rule before/after reboot.
Do not alter clocks, substitute live-frequency measurements or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve field applicability, expected MHz/unknown value and socket policy.
Decide any separate clock-behavior test and issue the metadata-case verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is correct, but grep loses record identity/raw field and cannot prove units, supported unknown or complete socket coverage; stderr is suppressed.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full decoded/raw Type 4 output with tool/errors, bind records by socket/status and compare the raw field plus dmidecode MHz representation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The External Clock scope, Type 4 script and 10/10-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Retain the raw 16-bit field and decoded MHz for every expected Type 4 record, apply the platform applicability/zero policy and compare semantic values across reboot without substituting dynamic frequency tools.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 4 systems; the field may be legacy or unsupported on modern processor designs.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, parser/dmidecode, BIOS, CPU and platform-recipe revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 4 External Clock semantics and approved processor/platform documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw units/applicability and explicit separation from core-frequency testing.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; adds invalid-unit and unsupported-value handling.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected MHz or approved unknown policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A static nominal/reference-clock field does not prove actual clock stability, boost behavior or performance.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve zero/unknown for platforms where External Clock is not meaningful or a nominal MHz value for legacy-compatible reporting, but must document applicability per socket/platform.
expected_evidence: Approval, expected MHz/unknown rule, platform/socket applicability and tool/SMBIOS versions
Complete pre-reboot Type 4 table with raw/decoded External Clock
Engineer verdict and separate clock-behavior reference if required

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item and criterion coherently target static Type 4 External Clock metadata; dynamic frequency behavior is outside the source scope.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The field is safely readable; expected value and modern-platform applicability are readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds complete record, raw value, units and unknown/applicability policy.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps static-versus-live distinction while correcting capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Explicitly separates External Clock from Max/Current Speed and handles legacy/modern platform semantics.

review_improvement: Prevents a static nominal field from being mistaken for live CPU frequency and avoids false failure on an approved unsupported/zero representation.
independent_technical_reasoning: After platform applicability and expected metadata are approved, the entire read/compare/reboot path is software-controlled; no clock manipulation or physical setup is part of this case.
